svg.title: Register a deployable model
svg.desc: Log inference.py and an inference specification on the MLflow logged model, then register it in MLflow. The automatic model registration creates a SageMaker model package version with the inference specification. An endpoint created from the model package downloads the model files directly from the MLflow artifact store.
svg.text: S3 artifact store of the MLflow app
downloads the model files to /opt/ml/model, no repacking or copies
